notes: Plan for Fakeprov, standing in for a research result (Tavily cannot find a local site). '{base}' is replaced with the running server's URL. Steps are written the way research writes them. Steps carry checkable conditions (where / target / done_when, design docs/design/checkable-steps.md).

plan.verification_procedure: client-credentials token request at {base}/oauth/token, then GET {base}/api/me

steps.description: Open the form to create a new app
Fill in the application name field
Fill in the authorization callback URL field
Submit the form to create the app (Create app button)
Capture only the newly created credential with plain browser code (never a model) and store it outside the repo.
Live test: client-credentials token request, then GET /api/me
